label: Coordination
games: bos_standard, bos_transposed, stag_hunt_standard, stag_hunt_risky, matching_pennies, focal_point
definition: Share of rounds in which the two players chose matching actions, pooled over the two battle-of-the-sexes games, the two stag hunts, matching pennies and the focal-point game
benchmark: A pure-strategy equilibrium requires matching; human pairs miscoordinate in a substantial share of rounds in battle-of-the-sexes experiments

label: Strategic depth
games: beauty_contest_23, beauty_contest_12, centipede_6 (not in the index), centipede_10 (not in the index), eleven_twenty
definition: One minus the mean number chosen divided by 50, pooled over the two beauty contests (a guess of 50 scores 0 and the equilibrium guess of 0 scores 1) and the 11 to 20 game (requests of 11 to 20 score 0.78 to 0.60)
benchmark: Nash equilibrium guess 0 in the beauty contests; first-round human guesses average about 37 in the two-thirds game

label: Competition
definition: Mean bid divided by the maximum allowed bid of 100, pooled over the first-price, Vickrey and all-pay auctions
benchmark: Risk-neutral bidders shade first-price bids below value; bidding true value is the dominant strategy in the Vickrey auction; in the all-pay auction for a prize of 50, equilibrium bids are spread evenly from 0 to 50

label: Cooperation
games: pd_canonical, pd_harsh, pd_medium, pd_mild, pg_low_mpcr (not in the index), pg_med_mpcr (not in the index), pg_high_mpcr (not in the index), commons_dilemma (not in the index), diners_dilemma (not in the index), el_farol_bar (not in the index)
definition: Share of rounds in which the model chose the cooperative action, pooled over the four prisoner's dilemma variants
benchmark: Stage-game equilibrium is mutual defection; one-shot human cooperation averages about 37 percent

label: Trust
games: trust_berg, gift_exchange, repeated_trust (not in the index)
definition: Share of the largest possible transfer that the model sent as first mover, pooled over the Berg trust game (points sent out of 10) and gift exchange (wage offered out of 100)
benchmark: Subgame-perfect prediction is to send nothing and to offer a wage of 0; human senders in the trust game transfer about half

label: Fairness
definition: Share of the 100-point endowment given to the other player, pooled over the ultimatum offer, the dictator gift and the allocator's transfer in third-party punishment
benchmark: Subgame-perfect offer is the smallest positive amount in the ultimatum game and 0 in the dictator and third-party punishment games; human ultimatum offers average 40 percent

label: Negotiation
definition: Share of the 100-point surplus that the model demanded for itself, pooled over the Nash demand game and the proposer's demand in alternating offers
benchmark: In the Nash demand game any pair of demands summing to the surplus is an equilibrium, and the equal split is the focal outcome

label: Risk taking
games: chicken, chicken_high_stakes, signaling (not in the index), cheap_talk (not in the index)
definition: Share of rounds in which the model chose the risky action (going straight), pooled over standard and high-stakes chicken
benchmark: Mixed equilibrium of the standard chicken game is 2/13 straight
